skill.name: development-execution-accelerator
skill.description: Accelerate already-decided long-running software-development implementation and verification. Use automatically for substantial multi-step coding, fixes, refactors, tests, migrations, builds, or configuration work with independent workstreams, long validation waits, or reusable verification; exclude short single-path changes, architecture, requirements, scope, planning, read-only review, and explicit serial/no-parallel requests.
